- [AutoStack Setup: Content Calendar | The Automate Stack](https://www.theautomatestack.com/setups/content-pipeline/): A Notion content calendar that fills itself. Claude writes the hooks and captions, makes the designs in Canva, and you approve. Nothing is ever posted for you.
- [AutoStack Setup: Income Tracker | The Automate Stack](https://www.theautomatestack.com/setups/income-tracker/): Every payment you receive has to be written down somewhere, and the writing down is the stressful part. This is a spreadsheet that Claude fills from your bank alert emails, so keeping a record of what you made stops being a chore. Works on your phone or your laptop.

- [The Automate Stack | Automated Sales Inboxes](https://www.theautomatestack.com/dm-automation/): Automated DM systems that answer buyer questions, overcome objections, and send checkout links in under 10 seconds while you sleep.

## Blog

- [The Automate Stack Blog](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/): All posts.
- [How do I plan a month of Instagram posts in one sitting?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-plan-a-month-of-instagram-posts-in-one-sitting/): Pick four lessons you already teach, one for each week. Give each week one job: a problem, a how-to, a real story, and an offer. Turn each lesson into a few posts with a hook and a call to action, then queue the whole month in one sitting.
- [What should I never paste into an AI tool?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/what-should-i-never-paste-into-an-ai-tool/): Never paste passwords, card details, full bank account numbers, ID numbers like your BVN or NIN, API keys, or private client contracts. Paste your own lessons, public information, and examples with the names and numbers removed. When in doubt, leave it out.
- [What should my Black Friday auto-reply say?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/what-should-my-black-friday-auto-reply-say/): A good auto-reply answers the question the buyer asked, gives them the next step, and sounds like you. Skip the 'we will get back to you' message. Write short replies for the questions you get most, with your price, your delivery details and your checkout link.
- [How do I get my Instagram DMs ready for Black Friday?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-get-my-instagram-dms-ready-for-black-friday/): Write down your offer and the questions buyers will ask, then write your answers once. Add a checkout link and a backup payment option, set up a way to send the answers without you, and test it with messy messages. Black Friday is on 27 November this year, so start now.
- [How do I turn one idea into a week of posts?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-turn-one-idea-into-a-week-of-posts/): Start with one lesson you already teach, in three to six sentences. Give it to an AI tool with your voice and a rule not to invent anything, and ask for one newsletter, three short captions and three hooks. Edit them, add one real example, and spread them across your week.
- [What happens to my Black Friday ad spend if I reply too slowly?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/what-happens-to-my-black-friday-ad-spend-if-i-reply-too-slowly/): Your ads keep spending whether or not anyone answers. If a buyer messages and waits, you have paid for the click and lost the sale. Fix your reply speed first, so every message gets an answer in seconds, even when you are asleep, and only then raise your budget.
- [What should I do before Black Friday as an online seller?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/what-should-i-do-before-black-friday-as-an-online-seller/): Decide your offer and count your stock first. Then test your payment and delivery, plan your content, get your DM answers ready, and run one full test the week before. Black Friday is on 27 November this year, so start now and work in order.
- [How do I know which tasks in my business to automate first?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-know-which-tasks-in-my-business-to-automate-first/): Start with the task you repeat most that needs no real thinking. Write down what you actually do for one week, then pick the one that eats the most time. Automate that one, test it, and only then pick the next.
- [How do I reply to Instagram DMs at night without staying awake?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-reply-to-instagram-dms-at-night-without-staying-awake/): Set up an automated DM system that reads the customer's actual message, answers it, and sends the checkout link. It runs on a server, not your phone, so a flat battery or a power cut does not stop it. You write the answers. The system delivers them.
- [Starter Kit or Blueprint: which one should I buy?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/starter-kit-or-blueprint-which-one-should-i-buy/): Buy the Starter Kit if you want AI to do real work in your business and you do not use n8n. Buy the Blueprint if you build with n8n and want 50 ready workflows. If you are not sure, start with the free Checklist.
- [Why does everything I write with AI sound like AI?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/why-does-everything-i-write-with-ai-sound-like-ai/): Because AI can only reshape what you give it. Give it a thin idea and it hands back a thin, generic post. Feed it your own words, your own example and a few plain rules, then edit what comes back before you post.
